conventions.normalVelocity: projected velocity minus population mean; no rotating-frame rate subtraction
conventions.rings: instantaneous cylindrical selections in fitted global plane; not tracked cohorts
conventions.warp: local median height and local normal versus fitted global plane
conventions.oddModes: antipodal initialization suppresses odd modes; pair correlations retained in null reference
conventions.basis: global x projected into fitted plane; possible geometric phase evolution under changing tilt

conventions.massQuantiles: inverse empirical mass CDF; no rank interpolation
conventions.potential: not evaluated; provide current specificPotential explicitly
conventions.virial: W_ij = sum m r_i a_j from caller supplied current field; surface terms not estimated
conventions.overflowBins: upper=null includes all radii above the last edge; density is undefined there
conventions.cylindricalAxis: R=0 particles omitted from cylindrical velocity moments only

flow.qualification: Least-squares linear flow subtraction is descriptive. Residual includes nonlinear coherent flows and random motion; not pure collisional heating.

particleRotation.method: Direct Float64 Plummer sum from current massive particles; finite azimuthal average; vc²=-R<ar>; squared contributions add.
particleRotation.qualification: Axisymmetrised circular-speed diagnostic, not mean particle rotation or an observational curve. Negative inward support is retained as signed v² and shown as a gap in speed. Finite-N noise and angular-quadrature error are not removed.

samples.qualification: Per-component self U allocated by half pair energy, external U counted once; individual component energies exchange. For fixed axisymmetric field only Lz is invariant. Specific binding signs are instantaneous diagnostics, not asymptotic escape proofs. Structure energy is omitted to avoid a false half external factor; use componentEnergy.
